title: ping.send
description: client → server. A player sends one of the eight enumerated quick pings, optionally pointing at an option of the active vote round. Allowed in every phase and while paused.

optionId.description: Option of the active round the ping points at; null for none.

OptionId.description: Identifier of one option inside a vote round. For PART votes it equals the part id; for CONTRACT votes the contract id; for PILOT votes a PlayerId; for quick votes an upper-case token defined in the vote-kind table (e.g. TEST, SKIP).
